notes: Feature release built from the usability audit: a Today section on the Dashboard; Client records open on My clients for caseload-scoped staff; Compliance lists follow-ups due and overdue loans; agency administration moves to its own Administration page (Alt+Z) with a support phone number setting shown to clients; Log a session and Mark completed can save the session note in the same step; clients have a preferred language and receive Spanish emails when set; the referral form accepts a phone number instead of an email; the portal has one Ask us form; invoices gain agency, month and text filters, a mark-all-drafts button and an optional work cut-off date for batch billing; reports share a remembered period picker; AT service modules cross-link. iPhone: optional local reminders (no client names), an offline read-only view of clients, today's schedule and follow-ups due, voice assistant context and auto-listen, referral waitlist and documentation review screens. Database migration: apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.27.sql (adds clients.preferred_language) before updating files. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21 and 3.0.27 in order; all are safe to re-run.
contact: Contact Example Agency for the update package.
